mapper.sql: FROM orders INNER JOIN users ON users.id = orders.created_by INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = orders.currency_center_id
mapper.select:
SELECT orders.id AS id, orders.order_date AS soDate, orders.order_code AS soCode, CONCAT(customers.name_kh, ' (', customers.name, ')') AS organizationName,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(quotation_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM quotations WHERE id IN (SELECT quotation_id FROM order_quotations WHERE order_id = orders.id)) AS quotationCode,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM deliveries WHERE id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM sales_orders WHERE order_id = orders.id) LIMIT 1) AS dnCode,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(pr_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM purchase_requests WHERE status = 1 AND id IN ( SELECT purchase_request_id FROM purchase_request_orders WHERE order_id = orders.id)) AS poCode,
IFNULL(orders.total_vat, 0) AS totalVat, orders.total_amount - IFNULL(orders.discount, 0) AS subTotal, orders.total_amount - IFNULL(orders.discount, 0) + IFNULL(orders.total_vat, 0) AS totalAmount, orders.is_close AS isClose, orders.is_approve AS isApprove, orders.type AS `type`, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS createdBy, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol
GROUP BY orders.id ORDER BY orders.order_date DESC, orders.order_code DESC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

( SELECT 1 AS type, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, order_details.qty AS qty, uoms.name AS uomName, order_details.unit_price AS unitCost, order_details.total_price AS totalCost FROM order_details INNER JOIN products ON products.id = order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = order_details.qty_uom_id WHERE order_details.order_id = #{salesOrderId} )
UNION ALL
( SELECT 2 AS `type`, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, order_services.qty AS qty, NULL AS uomName, order_services.unit_price AS unitCost, order_services.total_price AS totalCost FROM order_services INNER JOIN services ON services.id = order_services.service_id WHERE order_services.order_id = #{salesOrderId} )

SELECT products.id AS id, orders.order_date AS soDate, orders.order_code AS soCode, CONCAT(customers.name_kh, ' (', customers.name, ')') AS organizationName, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, order_details.qty AS qty, uoms.name AS uomName, order_details.unit_price AS unitCost, order_details.total_price AS totalCost FROM orders INNER JOIN users ON users.id = orders.created_by INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = orders.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN order_details ON order_details.quotation_id = orders.id LEFT JOIN order_services ON order_services.quotation_id = orders.id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = order_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = order_details.qty_uom_id
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(products.id) FROM orders INNER JOIN users ON users.id = orders.created_by INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = orders.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN order_details ON order_details.quotation_id = orders.id LEFT JOIN order_services ON order_services.quotation_id = orders.id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = order_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = order_details.qty_uom_id
